summary_sections.title: What this assessment measures
summary_sections.copy: RIASEC measures your interest strength across different work activities, such as hands-on work, analysis, expression, support, persuasion, and organization.
summary_sections.data_status_note: Source status retained separately. English operational status is UNKNOWN; not auto-promoted from Chinese metadata.

summary_sections.title: What this assessment does not measure
summary_sections.copy: It does not measure ability, personality identity, career success, income, job performance, or hiring risk.
summary_sections.data_status_note: Source status retained separately. English operational status is UNKNOWN; not auto-promoted from Chinese metadata.

summary_sections.title: How 60Q and 140Q relate
summary_sections.copy: 60Q describes the basic interest structure. 140Q separates task, environment, and role-responsibility clues. 140Q is more contextual, not more accurate, and it does not overturn 60Q.
summary_sections.data_status_note: Source status retained separately. English operational status is UNKNOWN; not auto-promoted from Chinese metadata.

summary_sections.title: How to read scores
summary_sections.copy: 0-100 is a within-form interest-strength conversion. It is not a population percentile and it is not an ability score.
summary_sections.data_status_note: Source status retained separately. English operational status is UNKNOWN; not auto-promoted from Chinese metadata.

summary_sections.title: How to read occupation examples
summary_sections.copy: Occupation examples only show where some activities may appear. When source rows are not attached, they must be labeled as content examples.
summary_sections.data_status_note: Source status retained separately. English operational status is UNKNOWN; not auto-promoted from Chinese metadata.

summary_sections.title: How feedback is used
summary_sections.copy: Feedback belongs to exploration, not measurement. It must not change assessment scores, report snapshots, or share content. In this version, feedback records are not connected to the report.
summary_sections.data_status_note: Source status retained separately. English operational status is UNKNOWN; not auto-promoted from Chinese metadata.

summary_sections.title: Quality boundary
summary_sections.copy: 60Q currently declares only a minimum answer-completion rule. It does not support a strong low_quality judgment.
summary_sections.data_status_note: Source status retained separately. English operational status is UNKNOWN; not auto-promoted from Chinese metadata.

summary_sections.title: Report snapshot
summary_sections.copy: A formal report must be bound to the snapshot at generation. Share, PDF, and history surfaces should read the same auditable result.
summary_sections.data_status_note: Source status retained separately. English operational status is UNKNOWN; not auto-promoted from Chinese metadata.

v5_editorial_note: LOCAL r2 candidate only. Eight sections and missing runtime boundaries are supplied for review; operational status remains UNKNOWN. No source or runtime review flags changed.

career_interest_only.label: Measurement object
career_interest_only.copy: RIASEC explains tendencies in work-activity interests. It does not measure ability, personality identity, career values, mental state, income potential, or probability of career success.

not_career_recommendation.label: Occupation example boundary
not_career_recommendation.copy: Occupation examples must be explained through activities and tasks. They are content examples, not matches, recommendations, rankings, or job-fit decisions.

same_scale_not_same_score_space.label: Score space
same_scale_not_same_score_space.copy: riasec_60 and riasec_140 both belong to RIASEC, but use different raw score spaces. Raw score differences must not be compared across forms by default.

riasec_140_contextual_not_more_accurate.label: 60Q and 140Q
riasec_140_contextual_not_more_accurate.copy: 140Q can only be described as contextual interest clues about daily work, not a more accurate answer.

content_examples_not_registry_match.label: Occupation example boundary
content_examples_not_registry_match.copy: Without a reviewed registry source, occupation examples must be labeled content_example_not_registry_match.

feedback_no_score_mutation.label: Feedback boundary
feedback_no_score_mutation.copy: User feedback belongs only to the exploration layer. It does not override measured_holland_code, dimension scores, or the formal report snapshot.

snapshot_bound_report.label: Formal report snapshot binding
snapshot_bound_report.copy: Formal reports, share, PDF, and history must use a snapshot-bound report as the basis for display.

quality_boundary_60q_minimal.label: 60Q quality boundary
quality_boundary_60q_minimal.copy: 60Q currently has no strong low_quality rule. It can only declare minimal_answer_completion_only.

runtime_disclaimers.label: Not an ability or personality measure
runtime_disclaimers.copy: RIASEC does not measure ability, personality, values, or long-term career outcomes.

runtime_disclaimers.label: Not for hiring or screening
runtime_disclaimers.copy: RIASEC must not be used for recruiting, promotion, elimination, or employment screening.

runtime_disclaimers.label: No cross-form raw score differences
runtime_disclaimers.copy: 60Q and 140Q do not permit raw score difference comparisons by default.

runtime_disclaimers.label: 140Q is not a more accurate result
runtime_disclaimers.copy: 140Q can only provide more specific contextual interest clues.

runtime_disclaimers.label: Occupation examples are not matches
runtime_disclaimers.copy: Occupation examples are content examples, not occupational database matches or job recommendations.

runtime_disclaimers.label: Feedback-layer boundary
runtime_disclaimers.copy: Feedback does not change measured_holland_code, scores, or the formal report snapshot.
